notes: Cross-verse consistency: the English 'upon' of ἐμπτύσουσιν αὐτῷ -> 'shall spit upon him' realizes the verb's ἐν- prefix, as it does for ἐμβλέπω -> 'looking upon' at 10:21 and 10:27, so it belongs inside the verb's unit and not to the pronoun as a case helper. The accepted alignment was the chapter's only instance of a prefix-realizing preposition split off from its verb, and it contradicted this verse's own treatment of 'again' inside ἀναστήσεται.
